rows.note: Use this all-purpose choice for a turning understood as a junction or place where a road branches, especially in directions.

example.english: At the turning ahead, turn right.
example.traditional: 去到前面個路口就轉右。
example.jyutping: heoi3 dou3 cin4 min6 go3 lou6 hau2 zau6 zyun3 jau6

rows.note: Use this for the physical bend or point where a road turns rather than an intersection.

example.english: This turning is very sharp, so drive more slowly.
example.traditional: 呢個轉彎位好急，揸慢啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zyun2 waan1 wai2 hou2 gap1 zaa1 maan6 di1
